purpose: Discovery screen of a distinct trend-by-seasonality task; controlled synthetic evidence requiring fresh replication
time: t=np.arange(-192,48); phase and intercept refer to future origin t=0
variance_scale: v=a*a/2+slope_magnitude*slope_magnitude*(H*H-1)/12;SAME across all cells and both periods per seed. Sum of component future variances,NOT realized mixture variance or future second moment.
primary_family: 3 unordered model pairs in fixed order timesfm,bolt,chronos2;later-listed minus earlier-listed;2periods;2contrast types;global Holm12
primary_pass: Either signed direction:abs(mean)>=.05,bootstrap95%CI excludes0,global Holm12 p<.05. Discovery only;promising effects need fresh replication.

inference.p: two-sided paired seed sign-flip plus-one;requires symmetry/exchangeability;bootstrap predictions fixed

measurement: Joint OLS[t/H,1,sin(2pi*t/period),cos(2pi*t/period)] with full empirical Gram. Describe slope/phase/amplitude errors and cross-component responses;never assume orthogonal loss components. Phase untestable below1e-6*true seasonal amplitude;MSE claims retained.
input_control: Known-period harmonic-plus-linear OLS fit to context and extrapolated to future;exact input baseline,not a learned activation result
descriptive: Pure-condition errors,actual background forecast error,component-sum improvement,relative slope/seasonal-amplitude errors,phase errors,full-Gram reconstruction checks
provenance: Protocol,metadata,worker source and adapter source hashes;offline cached checkpoint names;exact native repeats;independent Chronos2 group IDs and batch-permutation check
selection: Freeze before inference;no hidden capture,no uniqueness claims,no new agents,no ledger edits,no automatic expansion
